subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] OpenClaw WebChat: Conversation Management & Multi-AI Collaboration

question: Should this issue remain the canonical umbrella for WebChat conversation management plus multi-AI collaboration, and which remaining parts should OpenClaw core own versus plugins or narrower follow-up issues?
rationale: Current main implements a useful flat-session subset, while the remaining request defines durable product, API, UI, session-state, and orchestration boundaries that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for session/project organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

options.title: Narrow Core Scope
options.body: Limit OpenClaw core to session/project organization and route committee, meeting, and consensus workflows to plugin, skill, or RFC work unless a missing core API is proven.

options.title: Transfer Then Close
options.body: Close this umbrella only after moving all remaining requirements to clearly canonical narrower issues for projects, topic trees, and multi-agent collaboration.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Split Milestones
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require narrower maintainer-designed milestones for session/project organization, protocol/storage support, and multi-model collaboration.

likelyOwner.reason: They already provided the canonical-tracker signal and recently authored the merged session-thread management work that partially overlaps this request.
